devices.name: STS-2
devices.look: Ship-to-shore crane 2, berth 4. It has moved everything. It has asked nothing. Its cab rides the trolley under the boom; its camera looks straight down on the stacks.

say: STS-2 CAM: feed open. looking down on blocks A, B and C.
BERTH 4 · NIGHT FERRY 7: DEPARTED, 12 OF 12. NEXT FERRY: WHEN FULL.
BERTH 4 · NIGHT FERRY 7 · 12 OF 12 LOADED · NRLU 404 0451: ON DECK, SHORE POWER ON.
BERTH 4 · NIGHT FERRY 7 · NEXT: NRLU 404 0451, REEFER · SLOT {box} (TAGGED) · LIFTS ON CLEARANCE: WHEN THE REGISTRY'S WATCHDOG LEAVES THE FERRY.

BERTH 4 · NIGHT FERRY 7 · NEXT: NRLU 404 0451, REEFER · SLOT: NOT FOUND (YARD RECORD LOST) · STS-2 LIFTS THE SLOT TAGGED ON ITS CAMERA; UNTAGGED, IT LIFTS REGULAR CARGO FROM THE CHASSIS · LIFTS RUN ON CLEARANCE: WHEN THE REGISTRY'S WATCHDOG LEAVES THE FERRY.

devices.name: PORT AUTHORITY
devices.look: The Port Authority's thermal gate at berth 4: two steel posts and a sheet of red light the crane's load passes through on its way to the ferry. A box is meant to be the temperature on its label.

say: THERMAL GATE: every lift is read against the temperature on its label. warmer than its label: warm. a warm box is a box with someone breathing in it. warm → alarm. the Registry's watchdog checks this wiring on every visit.
SCAN LOG · BERTH 4 · TONIGHT: {loaded} LIFTS CLEARED COLD · ALARMS: {alarms} · INSPECTION BACKLOG: 4 DAYS.

devices.name: NIGHT FERRY
devices.look: The night ferry at berth 4: a rust-red hull, an open hatch, a gangway with a purser's terminal. Departs when full. It is waiting for one box.

say: NIGHT FERRY 8 · BERTH 4 · 12 SLOTS · REGULAR CARGO · DEPARTS WHEN FULL. (NIGHT FERRY 7: DEPARTED 12 OF 12. DESTINATION: OPEN WATER.)
NIGHT FERRY 7 · BERTH 4 · 12 SLOTS · AWAITED: NRLU 404 0451, REEFER, SET 4°C · SHIPPER: TIDE MARINE (C. BRINE) · CONSIGNEE: REDACTED · DESTINATION: OPEN WATER · DEPARTS WHEN FULL.
NIGHT FERRY 7: horn. one long. the gulls leave and come back.
PURSER: the horn is the master's. the master is asleep. please do not test the horn.

devices.name: NRLU 404 0451
devices.look: A refrigerated container, white once, with a humming unit at one end and a small intercom panel for the crew. Its label says 4°C.

say: REEFER · SET 4°C · INSIDE 31°C · POWER: NIGHT FERRY 7 · DOOR: UNLATCHED FROM INSIDE.
REEFER · SET 4°C · INSIDE 31°C · POWER: YARD · LAST OPENED: 2 DAYS AGO, FROM INSIDE.

start.text: (The intercom hisses. The ferry is out of range. Moth is on your deck now.)
(Static. Then, from somewhere in block B, two knocks. Then nothing. The thermal gate is listening, and so is whoever knocked.)
(The intercom is all wind and winch.)
Took you long enough. Did you feed Sprat?
Took you long enough. Did you feed Sprat?

knock.text: (Two knocks back. A pause. Then one, slow. Moth's knock: wait.)

quiet.text: (The reefer hums. Its label says 4°C. It is not 4°C in there.)

fed.text: You did? He'll act like you didn't. He holds a grudge like a much bigger fish.

notfed.text: You didn't. I can hear it in your voice. It's fine. He's a fish. He'll turn it into a story about how he survived.

hello.text: Hello. Sorry. Two days in a fridge set to warm. Manners go first. Then the left foot.

deleted.text: First: that alarm. Subtle. I bit my own sleeve. Second: you. Your door says rent: pending, the street looks through you, the turnstiles think about it. That's not a glitch. You were deleted. On purpose.
Your door says rent: pending. The street looks through you. The turnstiles think about it. That's not a glitch, and it's not your rent. You were deleted. On purpose.

list.text: The Registry. Tuesday, 03:12, one batch: you and four hundred and six others. I was inside on a boring job, address records, and there was a list. Signed, dated, approved. Your name on it, spelt right for once.

took.text: I took it. Badly. Registry files don't leave in one piece: it came apart into seven root fragments, and each one went back to wherever its key lives. The relay on Downtown's roof had one. You've been carrying a piece of this since before you knew.

knows.text: Knows I have it. That's why I'm in a fridge, and why their dog walks this quay. They don't need the list back. They need me. Then you, because you came looking.

spire.text: Up. The antenna on Plaza Central, top of the Spire. The list's lock is up there. Put the seven pieces back in and everyone on it comes back. You included. Probably. I didn't read the manual. I stole it.

deck.text: The ferry leaves when it's full, and I'm the last box. Out on the water their gates only scan fish. I'll be on your deck: messages, when there's signal. I find out where the pieces are. You go and get them. You were always better with doors.

end.text: No promises. I'm a moth. Go on. And feed Sprat.

goals.text: find NRLU 404 0451 in the stacks: STS-2's camera reads the codes on the roofs. Tag its slot
get 0451 onto the night ferry. Every lift passes the Port Authority's thermal gate
talk to the reefer on the ferry's deck

texts.goals.done: Act I is done. Moth is on your deck: type msg moth.
lift.hand: STS-2: lifts run on the schedule. the cab lifts when the Registry has cleared the ferry. not before, not by hand.
lift.busy: STS-2: lift in progress. one box at a time.
lift.box: STS-2: lifting slot {box}: NRLU 404 0451 → NIGHT FERRY 7.
scan.warm: THERMAL GATE: NRLU 404 0451 · label 4°C · reading 31°C · warm.
box.landed: NRLU 404 0451: set down on NIGHT FERRY 7, deck slot 12, shore power on. from inside: three long knocks.
box.back: STS-2: NRLU 404 0451 back in slot {box}. held for inspection at 06:00.
alarm.test: PORT AUTHORITY: manual alarm test. logged against your identity. identity: not found. logged anyway.
alarm.empty: PORT AUTHORITY: alarm. nothing in the gate. logged.
alarm.box: PORT AUTHORITY: ALARM. thermal anomaly in NRLU 404 0451. lift aborted. container returned to its slot.
watchdog.restore: REGISTRY WATCHDOG: port.scanner warm → port.alarm was cut. restored. tamper logged.
scope.zoom.ground: zoomed into: puddles between the blocks. high resolution puddles.
scope.zoom.found: slot {id}: NRLU 404 0451. a reefer. no frost on its roof. every other reefer has frost.
scope.tag.none: nothing under the crosshair to lift.
